backgroundLayers.osmInfoText: OpenStreetMap is an open, user-generated map that anyone can contribute to. The content is not quality-assured, reviewed or approved by Lantmäteriet (the Swedish mapping authority).
backgroundLayers.osmVectorInfoText: OpenStreetMap is an open, user-generated map that anyone can contribute to. The content is not quality-assured, reviewed or approved by Lantmäteriet (the Swedish mapping authority). This variant is loaded as vector data and therefore stays sharp on high-resolution screens.

common.geolocationPermissionDenied: You need to allow the application to show your position. On computers: most browsers have a lock icon in the address bar that you can click to allow Location.

confirmServiceSwitch.drawingCount_one: You have {{count}} drawn object in the map that isn't connected to any editable layer.
confirmServiceSwitch.drawingCount_other: You have {{count}} drawn objects in the map that aren't connected to any editable layer.
confirmServiceSwitch.note: Note: Drawn objects and editable layers are separate systems. If you keep the drawn objects, they'll stay in the map but can't be saved together with the editable layer.
confirmServiceSwitch.question: What do you want to do?
confirmServiceSwitch.selectingService: You're about to select the editable layer {{name}}.
confirmServiceSwitch.title: Drawn objects in the map

controls.presetDialogText: All visible layers in the map will now be hidden. The quick access predefined layers will be shown instead.
controls.presetInvalidLink: Unfortunately, the link to this place is invalid. Please contact the administrator of the map service to fix it.
controls.resetMap: Reset the map to its initial state
controls.toggleAttribution: Show/hide copyright information for map data
controls.toggleThemeTooltip: Switch between dark and light theme

cookieNotice.message: We use necessary cookies to make the website work well for you. We also use functional cookies to give you the best possible experience, if you accept them.

actionsMenu.intro:
Hide all active layers: turns off all layers in the map.

Scroll to top: jumps to the start of the layer list.

Scroll to bottom: jumps to the end of the layer list.
actionsMenu.title: Menu functions

actionsMenuButton.intro:
Click the menu button (the three dots).

The menu lets you: hide all active layers, jump to the top of the layer list or jump to the bottom of the layer list.
actionsMenuButton.title: Menu next to the search field

documentHandler.intro:
The document handler shows and manages texts connected to the map. The documents are standalone and can be reused in several maps.

With the document handler you can:
  • Show detailed texts connected to map bookmarks.
  • Combine text and map by adding map links that correspond to layers in the map.
documentHandler.title: Document handler

done.intro:
You've now completed the whole introduction. Want to go another round?

Click the button in the map controls to start over.
done.title: Introduction completed 🎉

drawOrder.intro: Click the Draw order tab to see and change the order of the layers.
drawOrder.title: Draw order

editFavorites.intro: The button opens a view where you can manage saved favorites.
editFavorites.title: Edit favorites

favorites.intro:
Click the favorites button.

Here you can save, edit and load favorites.{{note}}
favorites.noFavorites: There are no favorites right now. Add a favorite to enable this part of the guide.
favorites.title: Favorites

favoritesList.intro: Your saved favorites are shown here. Click a favorite to replace the current layers with it.
favoritesList.title: Favorites list

favoritesMenu.intro:
- Save to favorites: saves a group of layers as a favorite. You can set a title and description.

- Edit favorites: manage your saved favorites.

- Load favorite: loads the selected favorite. All active layers are replaced with the favorite's layers.
favoritesMenu.title: Favorites menu

favoritesOptions.intro: In the menu you can: show information about the favorite, edit it, delete it or export it as a .json file.
favoritesOptions.title: Favorite options

favoritesOptionsMenu.intro:
Edit: change title and description

Delete: removes the favorite from the list

Export: saves the favorite as a .json file
favoritesOptionsMenu.title: Favorite options menu

hajk4.intro:
This introduction shows how the new {{title}} works.

It illustrates the changes that came with Hajk 4.

Note that you can't do anything else in the application, such as clicking buttons or using other features, during the introduction.

Come along!
hajk4.title: Hajk 4

importFavorites.intro: Click to import favorites from a .json file.
importFavorites.title: Import favorites

layerDetails.intro: Click the button to show more information about the layer.
layerDetails.title: More information

layerGroup.intro:
The arrow shows that this is a layer group. Click to see the layers in it.

Note that layer groups in bold contain active layers.
layerGroup.title: Layer group

layerInfo.intro: Any information connected to the layer is shown here.
layerInfo.title: Layer information

layerList.intro:
The layer list shows all layers available in the map.

Here you can:
  • search for layers
  • turn layers on or off
  • see information about each layer
layerList.title: Layer list

layerSearch.intro:
Type in the field to search for layers.

The results are shown in the layer list below.
layerSearch.title: Search layers

legend.intro:
The button expands a section with the legend.

Click to show or hide it.
legend.title: Legend

lockDrawer.intro: Click the button to lock the side menu in place.
lockDrawer.title: Lock the side menu

mapControls.intro: On the far right of the screen are control buttons that you can use to navigate the map.
mapControls.title: Map controls

mapTools.intro:
The map tools have features that help you navigate the map.

This is where the tools placed in the side menu are shown.

Administrators can change where the tools are placed.
mapTools.title: Map tools

opacity.intro: Use the slider to change the layer's opacity.
opacity.title: Opacity

quickAccess.intro: Layers saved for quick access are listed and managed here.
quickAccess.title: Quick access

quickAccessButton.intro:
Add to quick access: the layer is added to the quick access menu under the Map layers tab.

Remove from quick access: the layer is removed from the quick access menu under the Map layers tab.
quickAccessButton.title: Quick access button

quickAccessMenu.intro:
Add active layers: adds all active layers to quick access.

Clear everything: removes all layers from quick access.
quickAccessMenu.title: Quick access options

quickAccessMenuButton.intro:
Click the menu button (the three dots) in quick access.

The menu lets you:
- add active layers
- clear everything
quickAccessMenuButton.title: Quick access menu

searchBar.intro: The search tool helps you quickly find the right place in the map.
searchBar.title: Search box

searchOptions.intro: Here you'll find more advanced search options.
searchOptions.title: More search options

searchToolsMenu.intro:
Here you can choose between different search tools for your search.

You can also click Search settings to open a separate menu.
searchToolsMenu.title: Search tools menu

systemLayerList.intro:
Here you can see and change the order of system layers.

Drag and drop layers to change the order.
systemLayerList.title: System layer list

systemLayers.intro:
Click to show system layers in the layer list below.

System layers are layers created by tools, for example the Sketch tool.
systemLayers.title: Show system layers

tabs.drawOrder: - Draw order: change the draw order of active layers in the map
tabs.intro:
Click here to switch between views:

- Map layers: shows the list of available layers

- Background: shows all available background layers

{{drawOrder}}
tabs.title: Tabs in {{title}}

themeList.intro:
Here you see the themes available in the map.

Click a theme to activate all its layers.

You can also search for themes in the search field.
themeList.title: Theme list

themes.intro:
Click the button to show themes.
Themes are predefined groups of layers created by administrators.{{note}}
themes.noThemes: No themes are available. Ask an administrator to create themes to use this feature.
themes.title: Themes

toggleLayer.intro: Click the box to turn a layer on or off. A layer name in bold means that the layer is active.
toggleLayer.title: Turn layers on or off

toolPanel.documentHandlerIntro: {{name}}: is a tool for showing larger amounts of text in Hajk. Click the button to show the side menu.
toolPanel.intro: {{name}}: here you'll find features and tools that help you interact with the map.{{documentHandler}}
toolPanel.title: Tool panel

welcome.intro:
This short guide shows you around the application. It gives an overview of the basic features and of what's new in Hajk 4.

Note that you can't do anything else in the application, such as clicking buttons or using other features, during the introduction.

👉 Come along!
welcome.title: Welcome

mapClickViewer.keyboardHint: Tip: you can browse the results with the ← and → keys on your keyboard

search.drawCircleHint: Press in the map where you want the center point, then drag outwards and release.
search.drawPolygonHint: Press once in the map for each node of the polygon. Run the search by pressing the last node once more.
search.extentSearchFailed: A problem occurred when searching the area. Please contact the system administrator.
search.hideResultsInMap: Hide search results in the map

results.filterFieldLabel: Text field for filtering the results
results.maxHitsReached: The maximum number of search hits has been reached. Refine your search to make sure that no important information is missed.
results.showNextFeature: Show next object in the result list
results.showPreviousFeature: Show previous object in the result list
results.sortTooltip: Sort the results, currently sorted by {{strategy}}
results.title: Search results

search.selectHint: Press the area in the map that you want to search. Hold CTRL to select several areas.

settings.activeSpatialFilter: Require the whole object to be within the search area
settings.activeSpatialFilterTooltip: If active, the whole object (e.g. a property) must fit within the search area to be included in the result. If inactive, it's enough that a small part of the object is within, or touches, the search area.
settings.caseSensitiveTooltip: If active, a search for 'a' doesn't match 'A'. Turn off to search regardless of upper/lower case.
settings.labelOnHighlight: Show text label in the map
settings.labelOnHighlightTooltip: If active, a label is shown in the map next to the highlighted search result
settings.limitSourcesTooltip: Turn on to choose which data sources to search. If off, all available search sources are searched.
settings.title: Search settings
settings.visibleLayersOnlyTooltip: If active, the search only covers layers that are visible and that the system administrator has set up for searching.
settings.wildcardAfterTooltip: If active, a search for 'road' also matches e.g. 'roads'.
settings.wildcardBeforeTooltip: If active, a search for 'road' also matches e.g. 'railroad'.

search.showResultsInMap: Show search results in the map

tools.extentTooltip: Search the entire area shown in the map.
tools.polygonTooltip: Search an area by drawing a polygon.
tools.radiusTooltip: Search an area by drawing a circle
tools.selectTooltip: Search by selecting one or more areas in the map.
